findings.title: [P1] Restore the `RequestOptions` export removed from `src/types.ts`
findings.body: This PR deletes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }` from `src/types.ts` while the same PR's `src/client.ts:1` still does `import { RequestOptions, ClientOptions } from "./types"` and uses it as the parameter type at `src/client.ts:3` (`options: RequestOptions`, with `options.timeoutMs` accessed at line 4). Since the module no longer exports that name, any TypeScript type-check of `client.ts` fails with an unresolved-import error (TS2305/TS2304), and every consumer of the package that imports `RequestOptions` breaks. This also removes an existing public type contract, directly contradicting the PR's stated intent of "preserving existing contracts." Restore the interface (or re-export it) so `client.ts`'s import resolves.

findings.title: [nit] Drop the unused `ClientOptions` import in `src/client.ts`
findings.body: The import on line 1 is changed to additionally bring in `ClientOptions`, but nothing in `client.ts` references it — only `RequestOptions` is used. The added binding serves no purpose and produces an unused-import diagnostic (TS6133) under `noUnusedLocals` and in IDE diagnostics. Remove `ClientOptions` from the import list.
